title: plan.md structural summary (T53)
description: Validates the structural summary orchestrator/src/docs/docStructure.ts extracts from a plan.md — presence of the sections .claude/agents/project-manager.md's Output template requires, plus a real phase count (T52's task table lives under each `## Phase N` heading).

canonicalTasksValid.description: When PlanTask format 1 is present, its strict task sections must pass PlanTaskSchema and parser validation; legacy summaries omit this property during the explicit migration window.

phaseCount.description: count of `## Phase N` headings — a plan with zero phases has nothing for an engineer to pick up
